# flowgx

> Inspect state machines and flow charts for unreachable, stuck and non-deterministic states. Reports problems with stable codes and exit codes, and writes an annotated storyboard.

flowgx is one of the `gxkit` agent-native review tools. Declare a state machine
as data; `flowgx inspect` proves every state is reachable, every state can still
reach an accepting state, and no event is ambiguous.

## Install

```sh
uvx --from "git+https://github.com/nekomario28/gxkit#subdirectory=packages/flowgx" flowgx --help
uv tool install ./packages/flowgx      # from a clone
```

Needs Python 3.10+ and Pillow.

## Use

```sh
flowgx inspect machine.py            # report + storyboard, exit 1 on any error
flowgx inspect machine.py --json
flowgx inspect machine.py --no-storyboard
flowgx render  machine.py -o machine.png
```

A machine file defines `machine` (a `flowgx.Machine`) or `STATES` /
`TRANSITIONS` / `START` / `ACCEPT`. Transitions are `(source, target)` or
`(source, target, event)`. With no `accept`, states with no outgoing transition
are accepting.

Or point it at a Mermaid state diagram: `flowgx inspect checkout.mmd`, or
`flowgx inspect README.md` for the single ```mermaid stateDiagram block it holds.
`[*] --> s` is the start, `s --> [*]` is accepting, `a --> b : event` is a
transition. Two initial states, a composite state, or more than one diagram in a
document exits 2 with its line.

## Checks

error: `no-start`, `no-accept`, `unknown-state`, `unreachable-state`, `dead-end`,
`no-exit`, `ambiguous-transition`.
info: `cycle`, `small-text`.
error (from the shared label layout): `clipped-text`, `text-overlap`.

Full documentation is in `README.md`.
